```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv('PLACES.csv')
head(data)
names(data)
```

- Filtering out unneccesary covariates, and assigning individual columns to the different measures

```{r}
data_filtered <- data %>% filter(Year==2023, DataValueTypeID == 'CrdPrv') %>%
  select(!(c('Data_Value_Unit',
                        'Data_Value_Type',
                        'Data_Value_Footnote',
                        'Data_Value_Footnote_Symbol',
                        'DataValueTypeID'))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Measure", values_from = "Data_Value")

data_filtered <- data_filtered %>% select(!c('Year',
                    'StateDesc',
                    'DataSource',
                    'Category',
                    'CategoryID',
                    'MeasureId',
                    'Short_Question_Text')) %>%
  mutate(
    loc_id = paste(StateAbbr, LocationName, LocationID, sep="-"),
    .keep="unused",
    .before = everything()
  )
head(data_filtered)
summary(data_filtered)
for (i in seq_along(data_filtered)){
  cat(colnames(data_filtered)[i], length(unique(data_filtered[[i]])), '\n')
}

```

- Sort by individual measure

```{r}
x <- cbind(data_filtered[,1:6], data_filtered[,17])
x <- x %>% drop_na(names(data_filtered)[17])
dim(x)
var_name <- paste0("data_", 17)
assign(var_name, 17)
head(x)
```

```{r}
# check for unique columns and counties 
for (i in seq_along(x)){
  cat(colnames(x)[i], length(unique(x[,i])), '\n')
}
```
